headline: PM Tarique and Erdogan discuss expanding trade and investment ties
summary: The leaders met on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly in New York to strengthen bilateral relations and explore new areas of cooperation.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Türkiye President Recep Tayyip Erdogan held a meeting to discuss ways to further expand trade and investment ties between the two countries.
The meeting took place on Tuesday evening (New York time) at the Turkish House near the UN Headquarters in New York, on the sidelines of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly (UNGA).
Both leaders expressed their commitment to strengthening existing friendly relations and exploring new areas of cooperation based on mutual interests and shared priorities.
They exchanged views on various issues of mutual interest to further consolidate and diversify the historic and friendly relations between Bangladesh and Türkiye.
The discussions also focused on possibilities for expanding cooperation in various sectors, including the economy, trade, and investment.
The leaders underscored the importance of maintaining close cooperation and coordination on various regional and international issues of common interest.
caption:
Strengthening ties in New York: PM Tarique Rahman and President Erdogan meet to boost trade and investment.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Türkiye President Recep Tayyip Erdogan held a meeting to discuss ways to further expand trade and investment ties between the two countries.

The meeting took place on Tuesday evening (New York time) at the Turkish House near the UN Headquarters in New York, on the sidelines of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly (UNGA).

Both leaders expressed their commitment to strengthening existing friendly relations and exploring new areas of cooperation based on mutual interests and shared priorities.

They exchanged views on various issues of mutual interest to further consolidate and diversify the historic and friendly relations between Bangladesh and Türkiye.

The discussions also focused on possibilities for expanding cooperation in various sectors, including the economy, trade, and investment.

The leaders underscored the importance of maintaining close cooperation and coordination on various regional and international issues of common interest.

headline_marked: 3 arrested for [[murder of Northwestern University student]] in Khulna
headline: 3 arrested for murder of Northwestern University student in Khulna
summary: The suspects, including a bank cashier and a Khulna University student, were apprehended in separate drives across Pirojpur, Khulna, and Barishal.
details: Three men have been arrested in connection with the murder of Md Azmul Hossain, a student of Northwestern University in Khulna.
The arrests were carried out in separate drives in Pirojpur, Khulna, and Barishal by the Special Response Battalion (SRB) and the Khulna Metropolitan Police’s Detective Branch (DB).
The arrested individuals are Hasnat Habib Rifat, 30, a public bank cashier; Tarek Hasan alias Rubel, 35, a private service holder; and Pratap Sarker, a student of Khulna University.
Rifat was arrested by a joint SRB team in Nesarabad upazila of Pirojpur around 2:30 am. Although not named in the initial FIR, he has been arrested as a suspect and is being interrogated.
According to the SRB, Rifat admitted his involvement during preliminary questioning.
Tarek Hasan alias Rubel was arrested by SRB personnel near Khwaja Hall on the university campus and was later handed over to Harintana Police Station.
Pratap Sarker was arrested by a DB team in Ujirpur upazila of Barishal around 4:45 pm.
caption:
Three men, including a bank cashier and a university student, have been arrested for the murder of a Northwestern University student in Khulna.

Three men have been arrested in connection with the murder of Md Azmul Hossain, a student of Northwestern University in Khulna.

The arrested individuals are Hasnat Habib Rifat, 30, a public bank cashier; Tarek Hasan alias Rubel, 35, a private service holder; and Pratap Sarker, a student of Khulna University.

Rifat was arrested by a joint SRB team in Nesarabad upazila of Pirojpur around 2:30 am. Although not named in the initial FIR, he has been arrested as a suspect and is being interrogated.

According to the SRB, Rifat admitted his involvement during preliminary questioning.

Tarek Hasan alias Rubel was arrested by SRB personnel near Khwaja Hall on the university campus and was later handed over to Harintana Police Station.

Pratap Sarker was arrested by a DB team in Ujirpur upazila of Barishal around 4:45 pm.
